Lakeside Respiratory Society (fictional). Synthetic test material — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE.
Practice Guideline: Blue Trainer Bellows Readiness (invented)

Background
The blue trainer bellows is an invented device used only in these tests.

Question 1
Recommendation.
We suggest that a bellows check is not needed before every drill (conditional recommendation, low certainty).

Question 2
Background.
Trainers commonly start a drill when the gauge reads 12 to 14 marks and stop if it falls below 6 marks, and some services use a cuff of 3 cm.
Recommendation.
We suggest drills can run with or without the cuff of 3 cm or less (conditional recommendation, moderate certainty).
